description: Delegate X (Twitter) work to the `grok-bot` subagent: search posts, read threads, look up users, export followers, following, likes or bookmarks as CSV, analyze an account. Grok Bot is a remote agent on its own cloud computer with Tommy's X account (@__morse) connected, plus a browser, shell, files, web search and image generation. Files it sends are saved on this Mac. Use when the user wants anything from X, or a long task that fits a cloud computer.
